abstract: We study preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, where a learner sequentially selects pairs of arms and observes binary preference feedback governed by the Bradley--Terry model. This setting naturally arises in applications such as recommender systems, tournament ranking, and learning from human feedback, where relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards. The observation model inherits the logistic bandit challenge of handling the problem-dependent constant $κ$, which accounts for the non-linearity of the link function and can grow arbitrarily large. Moreover, prior work has predominantly focused on linear or kernelized reward models, precluding the use of richer function classes. To address these limitations, we consider general reward function classes and introduce the \emph{locally sensitive eluder dimension}, a novel complexity measure tailored to the logistic structure of preference feedback that yields fine-grained regret guarantees without unfavorable dependence on $κ$. Building on this notion, we propose \textbf{GINOP} (Generic INformative OPtimism), an algorithm that constructs log-loss confidence sets and jointly selects arm pairs to balance optimism and informative exploration. We establish a first-order regret bound that, in contrast with what previous results suggest, demonstrates that learning with preference feedback is as statistically efficient as learning from direct reward observation. Finally, we corroborate our theoretical findings with empirical evaluations against competitive baselines.
key_ideas:
🔸用MLE最小化log-loss估计奖励函数，按覆盖数构造置信集Ft，保证f⋆以高概率始终包含在内。
🔸定义(σ,ε)-eluder维数：学习误差用超额log-loss度量，预测误差用˙σ加权平方偏差度量，从而把logistic结构的局部敏感性纳入复杂度定义本身。
🔸GINOP决策规则一步最大化ˆft(x)+ˆft(x′)+ωt(x,x′)，其中ωt量化臂对奖励差的不确定性；由于ωt(x,x)=0，算法天然避免选相同臂，鼓励比较不同臂以获得信息。
🔸通过Taylor展开与Cauchy–Schwarz分解遗憾，解二次不等式得到一阶遗憾界，κ仅出现在κΓT低阶项。
🔸线性与核化情形分别证明eluder维数为O(dlog(1/ε))与O(γT)，对常见核给出具体遗憾界。
analysis_summary:
🔸线性情形GINOP达到Õ(d√T/˙σ⋆+κd³)，在最优臂处˙σ⋆=1/4，主导项与直接奖励观测一致，匹配Li等人的Ω(d√T)下界，属极小极大最优。
🔸核化情形遗憾为O(γT√T/˙σ⋆+κγ³T)，对线性核、SE核、Matérn核κ项均为低阶，优于Xu等与Pásztor等的既有界。
🔸实验（T=2000、20次平均、30臂）显示GINOP在线性、核化（Ackley+Matérn核）及NN奖励设定下均优于MaxInP、CoLSTIM、FGTS.CDB、POP-BO、MaxMinLCB、NDB-UCB/TS等基线；仅多阶段的MR-LPF表现接近。
🔸局限：局部敏感eluder维数只用于分析不需实现，但通用函数类的高效oracle式实现仍是开放问题；作者也指出扩展到BT模型之外的观测模型是未来方向。
personal_view: 基于全文分析，本文的核心创新在于不依赖外部局部化技巧，而是把sigmoid局部敏感性直接写进eluder维数定义，从而在完全一般的函数类下移除主导项中的κ依赖，并澄清了Bakhtiari等局部化方法在广义线性情形的缺陷。这一结果对RLHF、推荐排序等偏好反馈场景具有理论奠基价值：它说明偏好反馈不必然比直接奖励更难学。实用层面，GINOP在线性/核化情形计算量与既有方法相当，实验规模虽小但趋势与理论一致。局限在于一般函数类的可计算实现未解决，且结论依赖BT模型与可实现性假设，实际人类偏好的模型失配可能削弱其优势。
